significance: One of the oldest Hindu foundations on mainland Penang, established at Bagan Luar in Butterworth in 1853 and given a permanent temple by Ponnusami Pillai in 1903. The present Dravidian structure, whose gopuram towers over the surrounding buildings, was raised in the 1980s and consecrated in 1988.
story: The temple is said to have begun when an image of Ambal was found by the seaside in 1853 and a small hut was put up on the spot to shelter her for worship.
